{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type=First Order |image=[[File:Goneril.png]] |name=Goneril |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[34 ABY]], ''[[Fulminatrix]]'' over [[D'Qar]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle of D'Qar]]—in which Goneril served aboard the ''[[Fulminatrix]]'' over [[D'Qar]] according to {{Film|VIII}}—to [[34 ABY]]. Furthermore, ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' establishes that all personnel of the ''Fulminatrix'' [[Death|perished]] during that battle. |species=[[Human]]{{Film|VIII}} |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Dark]] |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[First Order]]''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' **[[First Order Navy]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|He'll never penetrate our armor.''"
"''He's not trying to penetrate our armor. He's clearing out our surface cannons.|Goneril and Captain Moden Canady, on the ''Black One''|}} '''Goneril''' was a [[First Order Navy]] [[adjutant]] who served under [[Captain]] [[Moden Canady]] aboard the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]'' during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. In [[34 ABY]], the [[Siege Dreadnought|dreadnought]] traveled to the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] in order to destroy the [[Resistance base]] situated there. Before it could do so, a [[Resistance]] [[Black One|X-wing starfighter]] [[Resistance pilot|piloted]] by [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] began [[Battle of D'Qar|destroying]] the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} dorsal [[Point-defense laser cannon|surface cannons]]. Goneril proclaimed to Canady that the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|starfighter]] had no chance of penetrating the [[Star Dreadnought|dreadnought's]] [[armor]], leading the annoyed captain to retort that it was not, in fact, the attacker's goal. After the ''Fulminatrix'' eventually fired upon the base, destroying it, Goneril was transfixed by the sight of the resultant destruction on the planet's surface. The adjutant subsequently reported to Canady on the approach of [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber|Resistance bombers]] as well as on the progress of the re-charge of the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} [[Orbital autocannon|orbital auto-cannons]] for another attack, aimed at the Resistance's [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|main capital ship]]. Shortly thereafter, however, a successful [[bomb]]ing run by the last [[Cobalt Hammer|remaining Resistance bomber]] led to the destruction of the [[dreadnought]] and the [[death]] of all personnel aboard. ==Biography== ===Attacked by a single starfighter=== {{Quote|Captain Canady, why aren't you blasting that puny ship?''"
"''That puny ship is too small and at too close range. We need to scramble our fighters. Five bloody minutes ago.|Conversation between General Armitage Hux and Captain Moden Canady witnessed by Goneril|}} [[File:FirstOrderDreadnought.png|thumb|left|300px|Goneril was an adjutant aboard the ''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought ''Fulminatrix''.]] Goneril served as an [[adjutant]] in the [[First Order Navy|naval forces]] of the [[First Order]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between that faction and the [[Resistance]]. In [[34 ABY]], they were stationed aboard the [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator IV''-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]'', which accompanied three [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers]] in traveling to the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Ileenium system]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' in order to destroy the [[Resistance base]] on the [[planet]] [[D'Qar]] there. After the ''Fulminatrix'' arrived over the planet, however, Resistance [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]], [[Resistance pilot|piloting]] the [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]] ''[[Black One]]'', distracted the First Order [[warship]]s from opening fire on the base. Dameron then commenced an [[Battle of D'Qar|attack run]] on the ''Fulminatrix'', blowing up its dorsal [[Point-defense laser cannon|surface cannons]] in order to render the [[Siege Dreadnought|dreadnought]] defenseless against the Resistance's [[MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 heavy bomber]]s. [[File:CanadyGoneril-Databank.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Captain Moden Canady (center), under whose command Goneril (right) served.]] After the ''Black One'' flew past the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] to carry out another pass at the [[Star Dreadnought|dreadnought's]] [[Laser cannon|cannons]], the First Order's [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]] [[Hologram|holographically]] contacted the [[starship]]'s [[captain]], [[Moden Canady]], and angrily inquired as to why the ''Fulminatrix'' had not yet destroyed the attacking [[X-wing starfighter|starfighter]]. Goneril observed both Hux and Canady during the conversation. After the captain had scornfully retorted that their own [[Starfighter|fighters]] needed to be deployed—an action that Hux had previously forbidden—in order to effectively defend against the X-wing, he strode away from the bridge's [[viewport]] toward the room's interior. Goneril followed their superior [[First Order officer|officer]], proclaiming that the attacker had no chance of penetrating the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} [[armor]]. Canady briefly fantasized about there being an [[airlock]] situated nearby—through which he would then shove the adjutant—before icily responding that it was clearing out the [[dreadnought]]'s surface [[cannon]]s that was the X-wing's goal, not attempting to penetrate their armor. Goneril reacted with a look of offended incredulity on their face, which Canady would have treasured if not for the dangerous situation their vessel was in. ===Auto-cannon action=== {{Quote|Auto-cannons aimed.''"
"''Forty seconds to full charge.|Warrant Officer Suday Bascus and Goneril|}} [[File:ResistanceBaseDestroyed-TLJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Goneril was transfixed by the sight of the destruction wrought onto the surface of D'Qar by the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} attack.]] The captain of the ''Fulminatrix'' later gave the order for the ship's [[Orbital autocannon|orbital auto-cannons]] to open fire on the Resistance base. He then ordered for the feed of the vessel's [[orbit]]al imagers to be fed onto a [[viewscreen]]. The resultant images depicted a [[fire]]storm extending for [[kilometer]]s away through the planet's [[jungle]] from where the base had been destroyed. The sight transfixed Goneril, leading them to be standing frozen and staring at the screen with adoration. [[File:FulminatrixExplosions-TLJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Goneril and all other personnel of the ''Fulminatrix'' perished during the destruction of the ship.]] Later, while the Resistance [[bomber]]s were advancing on the ''Fulminatrix'', Goneril notified Canady that the attacking craft would be in range within moments, after which the captain ordered the auto-cannons to be recharged and to target[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 1|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 1]] the Resistance's main [[capital ship]], the [[MC85 Star Cruiser|cruiser]] [[Raddus (MC85 Star Cruiser)|''Raddus'']].''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' [[Warrant Officer]] [[Suday Bascus]] subsequently reported that the auto-cannons had been aimed at their new target, with Goneril adding that forty [[second]]s remained until they would be fully charged. The latter officer was standing near the console of another crew-member when Canady gave the order to fire at the ''Raddus''; however, at that moment, the last [[Cobalt Hammer|remaining Resistance bomber]] dropped its payload of [[proton bomb]]s onto the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} dorsal surface, causing a chain reaction of explosions within the vessel that eventually engulfed its bridge, with everyone aboard the warship [[Death|perishing]] as a result. ==Personality and traits== Goneril was a [[human]] with [[Color|light]] skin and dark [[eye]]s. They were confident in the ability of the armor of the ''Fulminatrix'' to withstand any attack by a T-70 X-wing starfighter, and the sight of the destruction wrought on the surface of D'Qar by the ''Fulminatrix''{{'s}} orbital auto-cannons transfixed Goneril and inspired adoration in them. ==Equipment== Goneril wore a [[First Order military uniforms|First Order military uniform]] consisting of a [[Clothing|tunic]], pants, a [[belt]], [[boot]]s, and a [[Hat|cap]]. They carried a single pair of [[Code cylinder|officer rank cylinders]] on the left side of the chest section of their tunic. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Are the auto cannons primed?''"
"''Primed and ready, sir.|Captain Moden Canady and Goneril, as presented in ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition''|}} [[File:AmiraGhazalla.jpg|thumb|right|200px|In ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'', Goneril was portrayed by Amira Ghazalla.]] Goneril first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. The character is portrayed by [[Amira Ghazalla]] and is listed as "Canady's First Order Commander" in the film's credits. Goneril was named in [[Jason Fry]]'s [[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition|adult novelization]] of the film, which was published on [[March 6]], [[2018]].{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/562319/the-last-jedi-expanded-edition-star-wars-by-jason-fry/9781524797119|text=The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (Star Wars)}} In the novelization, Goneril observes "disdainfully" the ''Black One'' approaching the bridge of the ''Fulminatrix'' while delivering their first line, "He'll never penetrate our armor," whereas in the film they say it while following Moden Canady away from the bridge's viewport. The novelization also erroneously attributes to Goneril a line said by a different bridge crew-member of the ''Fulminatrix'' in the film, as does''[[William Shakespeare's Jedi the Last: Star Wars Part the Eighth]]'' the [[July 10]], 2018{{QuirkBooks|url=book/william-shakespeares-jedi-last|text=William Shakespeare's Jedi the Last}} [[Canon|non-canon]] adaptation ''[[William Shakespeare's Jedi the Last: Star Wars Part the Eighth]]'' by [[Ian Doescher]]. In addition, the latter book has Goneril—identified only as "OFFICER 2"—deliver a line—"Resistance bombers make approach, my captain"— that is an altered version of a line said by Suday Bascus in the film. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *{{Film|VIII}} {{1st}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} {{1stID|Goneril}} *[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 1|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 1]] ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's Jedi the Last: Star Wars Part the Eighth]]'' ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Goneril}} *''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|captain-canady|Captain Canady}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Goneril |ja=ゴネリル }} [[Category:First Order Navy officers]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
